en.headline: Supervisory committee appointed to probe Yuen Long councillor conviction
en.dek: Five-member panel will examine disciplinary action against Sei Chun-hing, who was convicted of unlawful sexual intercourse with a girl under 16 and faces sentencing in October.
body: Authorities have appointed a five-member supervisory committee to investigate the conviction of Yuen Long District Council member Sei Chun-hing for having sexual intercourse with a girl under 16 more than a decade ago.

Sei, 39, was found guilty at the District Court earlier this month of the offence, which carries a maximum penalty of five years’ imprisonment. He was acquitted of a related indecent assault charge and has been remanded in custody pending sentencing on 27 October.

The Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs acted after the Yuen Long District Council chairman and three other members formally requested an inquiry under the District Councils Ordinance. The government has stressed the importance of the conduct and integrity of District Council members and said it will monitor the legal proceedings closely.

Sei is the first elected office-holder to face possible imprisonment for a criminal offence since the 2021 electoral overhaul that limited candidacy to those vetted as patriots. The supervisory committee will consider disciplinary sanctions under the established performance monitoring system for District Council members.

zh.headline: 當局委任監察委員會調查元朗區議員定罪案
zh.dek: 五人監察委員會將跟進施駿興與未滿16歲少女性交定罪案，考慮紀律處分，施已還押候10月判刑。
body: 當局已委任一個五人監察委員會，調查元朗區議會議員施駿興早前被裁定與未滿16歲少女性交的定罪個案。
現年39歲的施駿興本月稍早在區域法院被裁定該罪成立，最高可判監禁五年。他另被控一項非禮罪則獲裁定不成立，現已還押，將於10月27日判刑。
民政及青年事務局局長是在元朗區議會主席及另外三名議員根據《區議會條例》正式要求展開調查後作出委任。政府強調非常重視區議員的操守及誠信，並會密切監察相關法律程序。
施駿興是2021年選舉制度改革、候選人須經「愛國者」審查後，首名可能因刑事罪行被判監禁的民選公職人員。監察委員會將按現行區議員表現監察制度，考慮是否採取紀律處分。
